# Photographed surfaces

LAST LIGHT uses WebP copies of the original color, OpenGL normal and packed ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic maps. The runtime grades these for the lighting in each room. The photographed sources are [Poly Haven CC0 assets](https://polyhaven.com/license).

- Boiler room floor by Jenelle van Heerden. [Garage Floor](https://polyhaven.com/a/garage_floor).
- Boiler room block walls by Charlotte Baglioni. [Concrete Block Wall](https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_block_wall).
- Previous office floor by Amal Kumar. [Terrazzo Tiles](https://polyhaven.com/a/terrazzo_tiles).
- Archive ceramic by Dimitrios Savva. [Worn Tile Floor](https://polyhaven.com/a/worn_tile_floor).
- Archive plaster by Dimitrios Savva and Rico Cilliers. [Concrete Wall 003](https://polyhaven.com/a/concrete_wall_003).
- Rooftop surfacing by Dimitrios Savva. [Tarred Gravel](https://polyhaven.com/a/tarred_gravel).
